journey.name: Lift: every kind of equipment
journey.description: One free session logging a kettlebell set, a band set, a timed hold on one side and a bodyweight set with weight added. Each set is checked in its own words, Moved is checked to count only the weighed load, and the session is finished. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: Tap the "Lift" tab
Verify that "No sessions yet" is shown and an "Exercises" card says "Bells, bodyweight, bands and the mat"
Tap "Start session"
Verify that the session screen is shown with "Time", "Moved" at "0 kg", and "Log set"
Tap "Log set"
Verify that a sheet titled "Add to the session" shows "A set" and "An EMOM", and an exercise card reading "Two-hand swing" over "Kettlebell · Reps · Full body", with "Change"
Verify that "Bell" chips are shown, "16" selected, and "Reps" reads "10"
Tap "Log set" at the bottom of the sheet
Verify that the session shows "Two-hand swing" with a set "16 kg × 10", and "Moved" reads "160 kg"
Tap "Log set", then "Change" on the exercise card
Verify that the sheet shows "Search exercises", the chips "Kettlebell", "Bodyweight", "Band" and "Mat", and "Recent" listing "Two-hand swing"
Tap the "Band" chip
Verify that "15 exercises" is shown and the list starts with "Band pull-apart"
Tap "Band pull-apart"
Verify that the exercise card reads "Band pull-apart" over "Band · Reps · Upper body", and "Band" chips are shown from "Extra light" to "Extra heavy" with "Medium" selected
Tap "Heavy", then tap "Log set" at the bottom of the sheet
Verify that the session shows "Band pull-apart" with a set "Heavy × 10", and "Moved" still reads "160 kg"
Tap "Log set", then "Change", then tap "Clear" to drop the Band filter
Type "side plank" into "Search exercises"
Verify that "1 exercise" is shown: "Side plank", "Bodyweight · Time · a side · Core"
Tap "Side plank"
Verify that "A set" and "An EMOM" are gone, "Held" reads "0:30", "Added weight" offers "None" selected, and "Side" offers "Left" selected
Tap "+" beside "0:30" three times
Verify that "Held" reads "0:45"
Tap "Log set" at the bottom of the sheet
Verify that the session shows "Side plank" with a set "0:45 · Left", and "Moved" still reads "160 kg"
Tap "Log set" and verify that "Side" now has "Right" selected
Tap "Change", tap "Clear", type "pushup" into "Search exercises"
Verify that "3 exercises" is shown: "Push-up", "Incline push-up" and "Pike push-up"
Tap "Push-up"
Verify that "Added weight" offers "None" selected, then tap "8"
Tap "Log set" at the bottom of the sheet
Verify that the session shows "Push-up" with a set "+8 kg × 10", and "Moved" reads "240 kg"
Tap "Finish"

Verify that the summary shows "Done", "Counts toward your week and your goal", and under "New records" all four in their own words: "Two-hand swing" with "Heaviest 16 kg × 10", "Band pull-apart" with "Heaviest Heavy × 10", "Side plank" with "Longest 0:45" and "Push-up" with "Most added +8 kg × 10"
Tap "Done"
Verify that the Lift tab shows "Last session" with "Two-hand swing and 3 more", "4 sets" and "240 kg"
